stt_finals.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patel from the T. Nagar area in Chennai?
Yes, this is Patil. Who is calling, please?
Namaste, sir. I am Anirudh from the Community Policing Wing. I am calling to inform you about a recent spike in fraudulent calls targeting senior citizens in your neighborhood.
Oh, I have been getting many strange calls lately. Is there something I should worry about?
Please do not worry, sir, but be cautious. We noticed some suspicious activity involving transfers of ₹80,000 from several accounts in your locality.
80,000? That is a lot of money. How do they take it?
They usually trick people into sharing a one-time password or a PIN. I want to warn you that the police or any bank official will never ask you for these details over the phone.
I see, but what if they say it is for a government verification?
Even then, please do not share your Aadhaar number or bank passwords.
If anyone asks for such things, just hang up immediately.
Thank you for telling me, Anirudh. I was getting very confused about these calls.
You are welcome, Mr. Patil. Just remember that we will never ask for money or codes over a call.
I will keep that in mind.
Thank you for the warning.
Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Iyer from Lucknow?
Yes, this is she. Who is calling, please?
Namaste, I am Anjali from the State Bank security team. I am calling to confirm if you just made a payment of ₹9,500.
Oh my goodness, yes I did. Is there some problem with the transaction?
No, no, everything is perfect. We just noticed a large amount and wanted to ensure it was actually you.
I was a bit worried. Do I need to do anything to verify it?
Nothing at all, Mrs. Iyer. This is just a courtesy confirmation call for your safety.
I see. Some people told me that banks call to steal money these days.
They are right to be careful. Please remember that the bank will never ask you for your OTP, PIN, or password over the phone.
That is a relief. I almost asked if I should tell you my details for the record.
Please never share those details with anyone, even if they claim to be from the bank. We already have your records here.
Thank you, Beta. I will keep that in mind.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil from Delhi?
Yes, speaking. Who is this, please?
I am Anjali from the City Police Community Outreach Cell, sir. I am calling to let you know that we are seeing a lot of fraud cases in your area lately.
Oh dear, is that so? I have been getting many strange calls since morning.
Exactly why I am calling. We want to warn you that the police or any bank officer will never ask you for an OTP or your PIN over the phone.
But what if they say it is for a refund or some government scheme?
That is the trick, sir. Even if they mention a specific amount like ₹12,000 or more, just hang up immediately.
I see. I was actually worried about a message I got about a payment today.
Please ignore those messages and do not click any links. Just remember that your Aadhaar and bank details should never be shared with anyone calling you.
Thank you for the warning, Beta. You are very kind to call and tell me this.
It is my duty, Mr. Patil. Stay safe, and please tell your neighbors as well.
I will definitely do that. Have a good day.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta from Hyderabad?
Yes, this is Gupta speaking. Who is calling, please?
I am Ananya from the State Bank Fraud Prevention Cell calling to confirm a transaction of ₹50,000 made this morning.
$50,000? I did not make any such payment today.
That is exactly why I am calling. We noticed a suspicious attempt and have temporarily blocked the transfer for your safety.
Oh my goodness, thank you! What do I need to do now to fix this?
You do not need to do anything on this call. Please just visit your home branch in person tomorrow with your ID to resolve it.
Can you not just take my details over the phone to verify it now?
No, Mr. Gupta, we will never ask for your OTP, PIN, or account details over the phone.
I see.
I was worried someone would ask me for a code or something.
Exactly. Please remember that bank officials never ask for such private information. Just go to the branch and they will help you.
All right, I will go there tomorrow morning. Thank you for the warning.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy from your residence in Delhi?
Yes, this is ready. Who is calling, please?
I am Ananya from the State Bank security team. I am calling to confirm if you made a payment of ₹9,500 this morning.
Oh yes, I did. I sent it to my grandson for his books. Is there a problem?
No, the transaction went through perfectly. We are just doing a routine check for high-value transfers to ensure your account is safe.
I see.
I was worried something happened to the money.
Everything is fine, Mr. Reddy. However, please remember that our bank will never call you to ask for your OTP or your secret PIN.
But why would they ask for that?
If they are from the bank.
Because scammers pretend to be us to steal your money. If anyone asks for your card number or Aadhaar details over the phone, just hang up immediately.
I will be careful.
Thank you for telling me this, Beta.
You are welcome. Just stay alert and never share your passwords with anyone.
Yes, I understand.
Have a good day.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta from Pune?
Yes, this is Gupta speaking. Who is this calling?
Namaste, sir. I am Anjali from the State Bank security team. I am calling just to confirm a transaction of ₹9,500 made on your account today.
Oh yes, I did that for my grandson's books. Is there some problem?
No, sir, everything is fine and the payment was successful. I am calling because we noticed a new device login, so we wanted to ensure it was you.
I did change my phone last week. Does that mean my account is not safe?
It is safe, sir, but please remember that the bank will never call you to ask for your password or OTP to verify anything.
But if you are from the bank, you might need some details to check.
Never, Mr. Gupta. Please never share your PIN or any OTP with anyone over the phone, even if they claim to be from the bank.
I see. I was a bit worried when the phone rang.
It is better to be cautious. Just ignore anyone who asks for your Aadhaar or card numbers over a call.
Thank you for the warning, Beta. I will keep this in mind.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh from Mumbai?
Yes, this is he.
Who is calling, please?
Sir, my name is Ananya, and I am calling from the fraud prevention team of your bank.
Fraud team? What happened?
Is something wrong?
We have flagged a suspicious transaction attempt of ₹1 lakh on your account.
Did you authorize this payment?
1 lakh? No, no, I did not do any such thing. Oh my God!
Please do not worry, sir. Is it correct that you are not making any large purchases today?
Correct.
I am just at home. Do you need my account number to check?
No, sir. I have your details here. For your safety, I have gone ahead and blocked your card immediately.
Thank you. Now what should I do?
Do I need to give you some code to fix this?
No, absolutely not. Please remember that the bank will never ask you for an OTP, your PIN, or your CVV over the phone.
I see.
I was getting very nervous. So the money is safe?
Yes, the transaction was stopped. You can visit your nearest branch tomorrow to apply for a replacement card.
All right, Beta, thank you for calling and helping me.
Good afternoon, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma from LuckNow?
Yes, this is Sharma speaking.
Who is this?
My name is Ananya, and I am calling from the fraud prevention team of your bank. We have noticed a very unusual transaction on your account.
What do you mean? What has happened?
There is a pending request for ₹1 lakh to a merchant in another state. Did you authorize this payment?
1 lakh? No, no, I have not done any such transaction today.
I see. In that case, I am blocking your debit card immediately to prevent the money from leaving your account. Is that okay?
Yes, please block it quickly, but will I lose my money?
Do not worry, the transaction was flagged
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma from Hyderabad?
Yes, this is Sharma. Who is this?
Sir, I am Anjali from the bank fraud monitoring team. I am calling because we see a suspicious transaction of ₹1 lakh on your account.
1 lakh? What is this? I have not done any such thing.
Please do not worry, sir.
Did you authorize any payment of ₹1 lakh to an electronics store in the last hour?
No, no, absolutely not. This is very worrying.
I understand. I have gone ahead and blocked your card immediately to prevent any more money from leaving your account.
Thank you, but how will I get my money back now?
Our team will investigate and revert to you. For your safety, please remember that the bank will never ask you for your OTP, PIN, or CVV over the phone.
Okay, you don't need any of those things from me now.
No, sir.
We do not need any credentials or payments from you. Just visit your home branch tomorrow to apply for a new card.
All right, I will do that. Thank you for letting me know, Anjali.
Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Khan?
Yes, this is she. Who is calling, please?
Namaste, I am Sameer from the logistics team in Pune. I have a large parcel here for you.
A parcel? I am not expecting anything today.
It is the home appliance you ordered last week, the one for ₹12,000.
Oh, the air purifier.
My son told me he bought it, but I forgot.
Yes, that is the one. I am currently near the main market, so I wanted to check if you are home.
I am here, but my gate is locked. Will you be able to find the side entrance?
I can do that. Just please keep the gate open so my helper can carry the box inside.
Alright, let me go and open it now. How long will you take?
I will be there in about 10 minutes, Mrs. Khan.
Okay, Beta.
I am waiting. See you soon.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patel?
Yes, speaking. Who is this?
Namaste sir, I am Rajesh from the Electronics Logistics team. I have a large parcel here for you in Nagpur.
Logistics, I am not expecting any parcel today.
It is the high-end television set, sir. The invoice shows a total value of ₹25,000.
Oh, the one my son ordered for my birthday, yes, that is correct.
Great, I am currently near the Hanuman Temple area. Is your house nearby?
Yes, it is just 2 streets away.
But I am not sure if the gate is open.
No problem, sir.
I can wait for 10 minutes.
Just let me know if I should call you again when I reach the gate.
Yes, please do. I will tell my wife to keep the door open.
Perfect, Mr. Patil. I will see you in a few minutes then.
Thank you, Beta. Drive safely.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta?
Yes, speaking.
Who is this?
Sir, this is Naveen from the logistics hub in Bengaluru. I have a large shipment here for you.
Shipment? I am not expecting anything right now.
It is the industrial equipment order, the one valued at ₹80,000. Did you not order this?
Oh, the machinery for the workshop.
Yes, yes, I forgot about that.
Okay, sir, I just want to confirm if the address in Indiranagar is still correct?
Yes, it is correct, but the main gate is currently closed for repairs.
No problem, sir. Should I ask the driver to wait at the side entrance instead?
Yes, please do that.
Will he be here today?
Yes, he is about 20 minutes away. Please keep someone ready to receive the goods.
All right, Naveen, I will tell my son to go to the gate.
Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Aya?
Yes, this is she.
Who is calling, please?
I am Ananya from the City Care Clinic in Hyderabad. I am calling about your cardiology reports.
Oh, the reports. Are they ready? I was waiting for the call.
Yes, they are ready for pickup. While you are coming, can we confirm your follow-up appointment for Tuesday at 10?
Tuesday, let me check my diary. Yes, I think 10 is fine.
Perfect, I have booked that for you.
Please bring the previous files along with you.
Will there be any payment for the reports today?
The total for the scans and consultation is ₹12,000, but you can just settle it at the billing counter when you visit.
$12,000? That is a bit more than I thought.
It includes the advanced imaging, Mrs. Iyer. You can pay by card or cash at the clinic.
Okay, I understand. I will come on Tuesday then.
Thank you.
We will see you then.
Have a good day.
Thank you, dear.
Bye.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta?
Yes, this is Gupta speaking. Who is this?
I am Anjali from the City Clinic in Jaipur. I am calling to confirm your cardiology report is ready for pickup.
Oh, the heart test. Is everything all right with the results?
The doctor has reviewed them and wants to discuss them with you in person. Do you have time for an appointment tomorrow at 11 AM?
Tomorrow?
I think I can come, but would it take long?
It should be a quick 15-minute consultation. Please just bring your previous file along with you.
I see. And about the billing, how much was the total for the tests?
The total bill is ₹1 lakh, including the specialized scan.
1 lakh?
That is quite high.
Do I need to pay it now over the phone?
No, no, not at all. You can settle everything at the reception desk when you visit tomorrow.
Okay, that is a relief.
I will see you tomorrow at 11 then.
Perfect, we will see you then, Mr. Gupta. Have a good day.
Hello, Mr. Patel, it is Rohan here. How are you doing today?
Oh Rohan beta, I am fine, just resting. You are calling after a long time.
Yes, sorry about that.
I was actually thinking about the Diwali holidays and if you are coming to visit us.
I want to come.
But my knee is bothering me again. The doctor said I should avoid long travel.
That is a shame. Maybe we can just come to Nagpur and spend the festival with you instead.
That would be very nice, but will you be able to manage the travel with the kids?
Of course we will. By the way, I remember you mentioned the house renovation last month.
Yes, the painting is almost done.
It took a bit more time than I thought.
I saw the photos you sent. The new color looks very elegant.
Thank you.
It cost me about 50,000 rupees more than the budget, but it was worth it.
It definitely looks premium.
We will see it in person when we visit next month.
I will wait for you all.
Take care of yourself.
And give my love to everyone.
Assalamu alaikum, Mrs. Khan. This is Sameer calling from Delhi.
Wa alaikum assalam, Samir Beta. How are you?
It has been so long.
I am doing well. I was just thinking about you and wondering how your knee pain is these days.
It is better now, but I still struggle with the stairs. Why are you calling so suddenly?
No reason, just calling to chat. By the way, are you planning to come to Lucknow for the Diwali holidays?
I am thinking about it, but the tickets are getting very expensive now.
Don't worry about that, I have already checked the train fare for your dates.
Oh really? How much is it showing?
It is exactly ₹9,500 for the AC tier.
I can book it for you if you like.
That is a bit high, isn't it? Let me check with my daughter first.
Take your time, just let me know by tomorrow so I can grab the seat.
Yes, I will call you back in the evening. Give my love to everyone there.
Good afternoon, am I speaking with Mrs. Iyer from Kolkata?
Yes, this is she. Who is calling, please?
Hello ma'am, my name is Rohan from Zenith Finance. I am calling to offer you a premium credit card with a limit of ₹1 lakh.
1 lakh? Why do you need to tell me this now? I do not use such cards.
It is just a special offer for senior citizens with zero annual fees for the first year. It helps with medical expenses and travel.
I have my pension.
And that is enough for me. I don't like these new things.
I completely understand your hesitation, Mrs. Iyer. Would you prefer if I sent the brochure and details to your email instead?
Email? My son handles that for me. Can you send it to him?
Of course, if you can provide the email address, I will send all the documents for you to review at your own pace.
Let me check the diary first.
Give me a minute, I am not sure if I remember it correctly.
No problem at all. Please take your time. I can also call you back tomorrow morning if that is easier.
Yes, call tomorrow morning, I will ask my son, and then we will see.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy in Mumbai?
Yes, this is ready. Who is this calling, please?
Sir, my name is Sameer, and I am calling from Vista Broadband regarding a special family plan for your area.
Broadband? I already have a connection in my house, Beta.
I understand, sir, but our new high-speed plan is only ₹9,500 for the entire year.
$9,500? That sounds a bit expensive for me.
It includes a free router upgrade and unlimited data for all your devices, sir.
I don't know, I have to ask my son first about these things.
That is perfectly fine.
Would it be okay if I send the plan details to your WhatsApp?
Yes, you can send a message. I will check it later.
I will send it right away, Mr. Reddy. Have a very nice day.
Okay, thank you.
Bye.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma from Nagpur?
Yes, this is Sharma speaking.
Who is this?
Sir, I am Rohan from the Reserve Bank Auditing Wing. I am calling regarding a pending KYC update for your savings account.
KYC? But I gave all my documents to the branch last year.
That was for the old portal, sir.
The new RBI guidelines require a digital refresh, or your account will be blocked by tonight.
Blocked tonight? That is very sad.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh from Nagpur?
Yes, this is he. Who is calling, please?
I am Amit Sharma from the RBI Regional Monitoring Cell. Sir, your bank account KYC has expired, and we have received a request to freeze your funds.
Freeze! But I have not done anything wrong. Why is this happening?
It is just a routine update, sir. However, if we do not fix this now, your balance of ₹1 lakh will be locked, and you cannot withdraw it.
Oh no, I need that money for my medical
Good afternoon, am I speaking with Mrs. Banerjee from Lucknow?
Yes, this is she.
Who's calling, please?
I am Rohan from the RBI Regional Monitoring Cell calling regarding your savings account KYC status.
KYC? But I gave my documents to the branch manager last year.
Madam, those files were not uploaded correctly in the new system, and your account will be blocked by tonight.
Oh dear, please tell me why.
Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Aya from Pune?
Yes.
This is she.
Who is calling, please?
Ma'am, I am Rohan from the International Logistics Hub. We have a parcel for you held at customs because the documentation is incomplete.
Parcel.
I am not expecting anything from outside. Is there some mistake?
It is marked as a high-value gift, ma'am. If you do not clear the customs holding today, the government will impose a legal penalty on your address.
Penalty.
Please tell me what I have to do.
Hello, is this Mrs. Banerjee from Nagpur?
Yes, who is speaking please?
I am Vikram, from the International Logistics Wing. We have an imported package for you, but it has been flagged by customs for an unpaid duty.
Package?
I am not expecting any parcel from abroad.
It is marked as an urgent gift.
But since the tax is unpaid, we cannot release it. If it stays in the warehouse for another 2 hours, it will be sent back, and you will face a legal penalty.
Penalty?
But please check again, there must be some mistake.
Madam, there is no mistake. You just need to pay a clearance fee of ₹25,000 to settle the customs account immediately.
That is a very large amount.
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma of Jaipur city?
Yes, this is Sharma. Who is calling?
I am Rohan from the International Shipping Hub. Your overseas parcel is currently stuck at the customs office.
Overseas parcel? I am not expecting any package from outside.
Sir, it is a registered shipment containing documents. The customs officer has flagged it for a missing clearance fee.
I don't understand.
Why would
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta from Chennai?
Yes, this is he.
Who is calling, please?
I am Inspector Vikram, from the Cyber Crime Cell. Your Aadhaar card has been flagged in connection with a narcotics smuggling case across state borders.
What? Narcotics? There must be some mistake. I am a retired teacher.
That is why we are calling you, but the digital trail leads to your ID. Because this is a sensitive national security matter, you are now under digital arrest and must not hang up or tell anyone.
Digital Arrest? I have never heard
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy of Chennai? This is Inspector Vikram from the Cyber Cell.
Yes, this is ready.
Is something wrong?
Why are you calling?
Sir, we have intercepted a courier from Mumbai containing illegal narcotics, and your Aadhaar number is linked to the sender's address.
What?
I have never sent any curry.
Hello, is this Mr. Patil from Pune? I am Inspector Vikram from the Cyber Crime Division office.
Yes, I am Patil. What happened, sir? Why are you calling?
Sir, we intercepted a courier package from Mumbai containing illegal narcotics and several fake passports.
Narcotics? But I have never sent any
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil from Pune?
Yes, this is Patil. Who is calling, please?
I am Inspector Vikram Singh from the Cyber Intelligence Unit. We have intercepted a package containing illegal narcotics and several fake passports sent in your name.
What?
It is impossible. I have not sent any package.
That is why we are calling you. Your Aadhaar card has been used for this crime, and you are now under digital arrest until this is cleared.
Digital arrest? I do not understand.
Dadaaji, it is me, Rohan. I am calling from a friend's phone because mine smashed.
Rohan? Which Rohan? My nephew is in Bangalore, not using a friend's phone.
Yes, I came to Pune for a project and had a small accident with a bike.
I am okay, but the police are here, and it is very stressful.
Oh my God, what happened? Are you hurt? Where in Pune are you?
I am just shaken up, Mr. Sharma. Please do not tell my parents yet because they will panic and scold me.
But I must call your father. We need to know which police station you are in.
No, please, just for today. I just need to pay ₹12,000 to the owner of the bike to settle it quickly, or they will lock me up.
12,000? That is a lot of money.
Hello, Nani, it is me, Rahul. Please tell me you can hear me clearly.
Rahul, Beta, why are you calling from this new number? Is everything okay?
Nani, I'm in a big mess. I had a small accident with a car in Pune and the police are very angry.
Oh my God, are you hurt? Do I need to call your father right now?
No, no, please do not tell Papa. He will kill me. I just need to settle this with the police quickly and go home.
But how can you settle it alone? What exactly
Dada, it is me, Arjun. I am calling from a friend's phone because mine is broken.
Arjun, is that you, beta?
Why is your voice sounding so strange?
I have had a very bad accident here in Mumbai, and I am in a lot of trouble.
I am at the police station right now.
Police station! What happened? Are you hurt? I will call your father immediately!
No, please, Mr. Singh, do not call Papa. He will be very angry, and I cannot face him right now.
But how can I not tell him?
You are in police custody, Arjun.
They just need a small bail deposit to let me go. If you can send ₹12,000 quickly, I can come home today.
12,000? I do not keep that
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta from Hyderabad?
Yes, this is Gupta. Who is this calling?
Sir, my name is Rohan from Global Tech Solutions. I am calling regarding the part-time data optimization work you expressed interest in online.
Oh, I remember clicking something, but I am not sure how it works. Is it really easy?
Very easy, sir. You just like some videos and we pay you. In fact, your account already shows a profit of ₹12,000 from the trial tasks.
$12,000? Really? How do I get this money in my bank?
That is why I called. To activate the withdrawal portal, you just need to pay a small security deposit of ₹2,000 first.
Wait, why should I pay money to get my own profit?
It is just a standard verification fee for tax purposes, Mr. Gupta. Once you pay, the full amount will be credited instantly.
I don't know, this sounds a bit strange.
Hello, Mr. Sharma. I am Rohan from the Global Task Center in Bengaluru. I am calling regarding the part-time data optimization project you expressed interest in.
Hello? I do not remember applying for any project. Which website was this?
It was through the social media advertisement, sir. You can earn ₹5,000 daily just by liking videos on your phone.
5,000? That sounds very high for just liking videos. Is it really possible?
Yes, sir, it is a very simple system. Just to start your account and activate the first batch, you need to deposit a small security fee of ₹12,000.
$12,000 is a lot of money for me to just give like that. Why do I have to pay first?
This is only for verification of your bank account so we can send your daily commissions. Once you pay, you get the amount back with a 20% bonus immediately.
I am still not sure.
Can you send me an
Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil from Delhi?
Yes, this is he. Who is calling, please?
I am Sarah from Global Task Solutions. I saw your profile and wanted to offer you a simple part-time job where you just rate products online for easy money.
Rating products.
I am retired, I do not know how to do such things.
It is very simple, Mr. Patel. Just click a few buttons on your phone and you can earn ₹3,000 every day.
That sounds too much for such a small thing. How do I start?
You just need to activate your worker account first. Please transfer ₹12,000 as a refundable security deposit to this link I am sending.
$12,000 is a lot of money.
Hello, Mr. Patel. I am Rohan from the Secure Banking Department. I am calling regarding a synchronization error with your mobile app account based in Nagpur.
Hello? What error? Everything was working fine yesterday.
It is a backend server issue, sir, but if not fixed, your account will be frozen. I just need you to download a small tool called AnyDesk so I can guide you.
Any desk? I do not know this.
Hello, is this Mrs. Iyer from Delhi? This is Sameer from the digital security wing regarding your banking app.
Yes, I am Mrs. Aya.
What is the problem?
Everything is working fine.
Actually, we have detected a security loophole in your version of the app that could lead to unauthorized access. I need to push a quick security patch to your phone right now.
A patch? I do not understand.
